passages.text: Nina and Omar are writing a story together for the class reading corner. Nina is good at describing places, so she writes about the garden where the story begins. Omar enjoys writing what people say, and he adds a conversation between the two friends. At first, the story has a sad end: one friend leaves without saying anything. After reading it aloud, they change the final scene so that the friends explain their feelings. Both writers think this ending makes their story clearer and more complete.

parallelText.en: Nina and Omar are writing a story together for the class reading corner.
parallelText.zh: 妮娜和奥马尔正在为班级阅读角一起写故事。

parallelText.en: Nina is good at describing places, so she writes about the garden where the story begins.
parallelText.zh: 妮娜擅长描写地点，因此她描写故事开头的花园。

parallelText.en: Omar enjoys writing what people say, and he adds a conversation between the two friends.
parallelText.zh: 奥马尔喜欢写人物的话，因此加了一段两位朋友的对话。

parallelText.en: At first, the story has a sad end: one friend leaves without saying anything.
parallelText.zh: 起初，故事有个悲伤的结局：一位朋友什么也没说就离开了。

parallelText.en: After reading it aloud, they change the final scene so that the friends explain their feelings.
parallelText.zh: 朗读之后，他们修改最后一幕，让朋友们说明自己的感受。

parallelText.en: Both writers think this ending makes their story clearer and more complete.
parallelText.zh: 两位作者都认为，这个结局让故事更清楚、完整。

wordHelp.meaning: one part of a story or play

passages.text: Our class makes paper birds for a small school science activity. We take them outside on a windy afternoon and hold the strings carefully. When a stronger wind comes, some paper birds rise above our heads. Mine falls at first, so I change the fold and try again with a classmate. We are glad when it stays up for a few seconds instead of dropping at once. We compare our birds and talk about what helped them stay in the air.

parallelText.en: Our class makes paper birds for a small school science activity.
parallelText.zh: 我们班为一项学校科学小活动制作纸鸟。

parallelText.en: We take them outside on a windy afternoon and hold the strings carefully.
parallelText.zh: 一个有风的下午，我们把纸鸟带到户外，小心握住细绳。

parallelText.en: When a stronger wind comes, some paper birds rise above our heads.
parallelText.zh: 一阵更强的风吹来时，一些纸鸟升到我们的头顶上方。

parallelText.en: Mine falls at first, so I change the fold and try again with a classmate.
parallelText.zh: 我的纸鸟起初掉了下来，于是我调整折痕，和一位同学一起再试一次。

parallelText.en: We are glad when it stays up for a few seconds instead of dropping at once.
parallelText.zh: 当它留在空中几秒、没有立刻掉下来时，我们很高兴。

parallelText.en: We compare our birds and talk about what helped them stay in the air.
parallelText.zh: 我们比较各自的纸鸟，讨论什么帮助它们停留在空中。
